_comment: MiniMax H3 ref2va, PRUNED nvfp4 weights + EasyCache. Replaces the pruned_int8_convrot / beta graph as of 2026-08-03 (founder call), adapted verbatim from his own ComfyUI export. Three things changed at once and NONE of them is covered by the calibration table in dhee-cofounder/artifacts/h3-r2v-probe/README.md (which measured int8 + beta): the UNET is now pruned_nvfp4 (founder call 2026-08-03: the pruned nvfp4 build, not the full one -- pruned is the smaller/faster of the two nvfp4 variants on the box, mirroring how the int8 graph used pruned_int8_convrot rather than the unpruned int8), an EasyCache node wraps the model (reuse_threshold 0.3, active 20%-90% of the schedule) and the scheduler is bong_tangent. EasyCache trades fidelity for speed by reusing steps, so if identity or motion degrades against a previously-good render, EasyCache is the first thing to bisect -- raise reuse_threshold toward 0 or delete the CACHE node and point GUIDER/SIGMAS back at UNET. NOTE the runner OVERRIDES BasicScheduler.scheduler from cfg.scheduler, so bong_tangent only takes effect because the bundle node sets it; changing it here alone does nothing. Calibration also showed scheduler choice is free (beta 7.74 vs simple 7.65 s/it) and that cost scales as ~pixels^1.3, so resolution -- not the scheduler -- is the cost dial.
